text: Flaw found 2026-10-16: accessKeyAnnouncement is signed with the previous epoch access key, which a member being removed also holds; they can forge an announcement for a key only they know, race the real one, keep relay access and lock out legitimate members (availability, not confidentiality). DECIDED (Mark), option A: every accessKeyAnnouncement MUST be countersigned by the CO registration service (billing key) to be accepted; if the service is unreachable the relay keeps accepting the last vouched key. Bead stays open for external cryptographic review.
